description: This file contains utility functions and a class method for importing and updating dashboard configurations in Apache Superset, including ID remapping, metadata updates, and dashboard import logic.

methods.name: find_chart_uuids
methods.description: Finds all chart UUIDs in a given position dictionary.

methods.name: find_native_filter_datasets
methods.description: Extracts dataset UUIDs from native filter configurations in metadata.

methods.name: build_uuid_to_id_map
methods.description: Builds a mapping from chart UUIDs to chart IDs from position data.

methods.name: update_id_refs
methods.description: Updates dashboard configuration to replace old IDs with new IDs, including position, metadata, and native filter references.

methods.name: update_cross_filter_scoping
methods.description: Remaps cross filter scope references within dashboard configuration.

methods.name: import_dashboard
methods.description: Imports or updates a dashboard in the database, handling permissions, existing dashboards, and metadata adjustments.
